name: Fleet Knowledge and Learning Assistant
desc: Answers fleet staff questions on safety, pre-starts, fatigue, load restraint and Chain of Responsibility with numbered sources, and runs short learning modules with quizzes and toolbox talks.
notes: New build with a sample fleet library of 8 procedures and 34 clauses: AI answers questions tailored to the asker's role citing only matched clauses (library search when AI is off) and flags gaps for the knowledge owner, a Learn tab runs role pathways with key points, sample or AI quizzes and a copyable completion summary, and a Toolbox talk tab drafts a five minute talk; all procedures, limits and people are made-up samples, names, phone numbers and registrations are swapped for placeholders before AI, and Steps to productionise and Draft in Outlook were added.
tested: Playwright smoke test at 1280 light and 390 dark in AI-off mode: ask flow with sources and citation jump, uncovered question and gap flag, Learn module quiz and score, toolbox talk draft, no page errors, no horizontal overflow, Steps to productionise panel opens, Draft in Outlook links present on Copy answer, Copy gap list, Copy completion summary and Copy toolbox talk.
